steps.q: Does it make a great product or service?

views.text: In April 2024, Equity Mates said Zealand Pharma reported about 15% weight loss over 46 weeks in trials, similar to results from Amgen and Viking Therapeutics, showing it had a credible obesity treatment in a competitive field.
